observations.title: Reduce client load while inactive
observations.player_action: Leave the client inactive/minimized or idle for its configured interval.
observations.outcome: FPS falls to the configured idle limit and returns when the user operates the game.
conditions: This reduces rendering load; it does not pause the dedicated server or prove gameplay stops.
External documentation is not installed-runtime proof; inspect the installed artifact/configuration before relying on defaults or exact compatibility.
observations.review_note: Presentation/settings alone do not provide an inventory completion signal. Any quest would require a documented native action or explicit manual confirmation.
